purpose: Document first-party local land-registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: DBKU GISKU public layer descriptions omit cadastral parcels. eLASIS cadastral maps/title searches use account/SarawakPass workflows and map products are paid; no anonymous geometry schema or feature response was verified.
registryAssessment: Sarawak Land and Survey Department and its eLASIS services are based in Kuching and provide land registry and cadastral-map products. This establishes local registry activity, not open vector access.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Kuching North City Commission GISKU description lists administrative boundary, tourism, zoning, roads, waterways, commercial and public-service layers; cadastral parcel boundaries are not listed.
Official Sarawak eLASIS portal provides land/cadastral products; the reviewed access path requires SarawakPass/account and cadastral map products are sold.
Official Sarawak Land and Survey Department portal; the department’s eLASIS materials describe cadastral map and title-search services, not anonymous downloadable full-polygon features.
